usedFor: Cal.com holds bookings, and HubSpot keeps the contact history that “Add Notes to Contact” writes into.

bestTemplate.name: “Booking Created” in Cal.com, then “Add Notes to Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Each new booking leaves a dated note on the HubSpot contact, so sales sees the meeting.

watchOut: “Add Notes to Contact” needs a contact ID or email, and “Booking Reschedules” would add a second note.
